_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY: an invented vendor format showing how to describe the real MQTT format without code. Topic plant/<station>/gamma/<gateway>; each message carries a list of readings with ISO-8601 times; dose rates in nGy/h unless a unit is given; vendor states map to normal|h1|h2|fault|offline (stored, never dropped); vendor ids map to stations.json ids (device_id "_station" = station-level metric such as battery_voltage). Test with: python scripts/ingest_mqtt.py --file data/mqtt/captured.example.jsonl --dry-run --parser mapping --mapping data/mqtt/mapping.example.json
